 izna — K-Pop Group Lights Up Singapore with Debut Concert Tour
 Nov 13, 2026 12:13 AM PST [Photo] OSEN DB. 
 Girl group izna has successfully wrapped up their concert in Singapore, further proving their rising global momentum on the international stage.
 According to their agency WAKEONE on the 13th, izna members (Mai, Bang Ji-min, Koko, Yu Sarang, Choi Jung-eun, Jeong Sae-bi) successfully held their first debut concert tour titled ‘2026-2027 izna Concert Tour: WHO DAT GIRL?’ in Singapore on the 8th local time.
 Underlining their ambition to capture everyone’s attention instantly as the ultimate ‘DAT GIRL,’ izna presented a full live band arrangement for this tour, reimagining their existing tracks into vibrant band, bossa nova, and house remix versions. Combined with the group’s signature synchronized choreography, they fully displayed their true value as a ‘performance-driven artist.’
 Major local media outlets in Singapore highlighted the event with headlines such as ‘izna heats up the Singapore night with high-energy performances.’ They praised the group’s musical growth, showcased through a diverse setlist spanning from their debut tracks to their latest releases, as well as the deep connection built with fans through sing-alongs and ocean waves of light sticks.
 Furthermore, izna is expanding its fandom presence beyond Asia into North America, having met and been interviewed by JoJo Wright, a popular DJ from the major U.S. radio channel 102.7 KIIS FM.
 Through their agency, izna shared their heartfelt thoughts: ‘We have been working hard to show various sides of ourselves on many stages since our debut, and we are always grateful to naya (our fandom) because we were able to grow every time. Please look forward to seeing even more wonderful sides of us in the future.’
 Meanwhile, izna will continue the momentum of their ‘WHO DAT GIRL?’ concert tour in Kuala Lumpur on December 5th, followed by Fukuoka on March 12, 2027, Tokyo on the 14th, Nagoya on the 27th, and Osaka on the 28th.
